'''Secter 3''' was a location on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Formos/Legends|Formos]] in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]].

==History==
Secter 3 was close to the spaceport where [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] landed the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] on Formos when smuggling [[Spice/Legends|spice]] from the planet. A sign pointing to the location was painted on the outside of the ''Falcon''{{'s}} landing bay.
